name: clean-closed-issue-worktrees
title_zh: 先问议题关没关再动手删的 Git 工作树清理工
tagline_zh: 扫一眼工作树，自动核对 GitHub/GitLab 议题状态，只清已关闭的，顺手报出能省多少磁盘。
tagline_en: Scan worktrees, verify issue/PR/MR state, delete only closed ones, and see disk savings before you commit.
desc_en: Safely audit and remove Git worktrees linked to closed GitHub or GitLab issues. Use when scanning worktrees, verifying issue/PR/MR state, estimating space savings, or cleaning completed work.
why_zh: 别的清理工具只看分支名猜，它直接问远端议题状态，关没关一查便知。安全边际高，删前先算账。
why_en: Unlike tools that guess from branch names, it queries remote issue state—so you never delete a live worktree by mistake.
limit_zh: 只认 GitHub 和 GitLab 的议题/PR/MR 链接，且需本地有 gh/glab 命令并已登录。
limit_en: Only works with GitHub/GitLab issue/PR/MR links; requires gh/glab CLI installed and authenticated. Unlinked worktrees are skipped; deletions need.
title_en: Git worktree cleaner that checks issue state first
